name: lesson-15
description: Bài 15 — tài liệu, nghề nghiệp, nơi chốn, hành động; cảnh xin phép.

cells.subject: a neat stack of printed documents held by a black binder clip, pages showing only blank grey lines
an open glossy product catalogue showing pictures of cameras on its pages, no text

alt.vi: Cuốn catalogue mở ra có hình máy ảnh.

cells.subject: a folded train timetable leaflet with a blank grid of empty rows and a small train picture at the top, no numbers

alt.vi: Tờ bảng giờ tàu gấp đôi.

cells.subject: an open clamshell electronic dictionary with a blank screen and blank keyboard keys

alt.vi: Chiếc từ điển điện tử mở nắp.

jobs.subject: the reference male student placing his backpack down on a low wooden bench, bending slightly; full figure from head to shoes

alt.vi: Cậu sinh viên đặt ba lô lên ghế.

jobs.subject: the reference woman making rice balls with her hands at a small table with a bowl of rice and a plate of finished rice balls

alt.vi: Cô gái đang nặn cơm nắm.

jobs.subject: a smiling baker behind a small bread stall holding out a paper bag of bread to sell, loaves displayed on the counter

alt.vi: Người bán hàng đưa túi bánh mì cho khách.

jobs.subject: a researcher in a white lab coat looking into a microscope at a lab bench with glass flasks

alt.vi: Nhà nghiên cứu nhìn vào kính hiển vi.

jobs.subject: a small clothes rack with a shirt, a sweater and a pair of trousers hanging on wooden hangers

a wide, low civic city hall building with a broad stone entrance stairway, a flagpole with a plain blank flag and a small clock tower whose face has no numerals; no people at all; compact composition: the building and its trees stay well inside the canvas, never reaching any edge

alt.vi: Tòa nhà ủy ban thành phố.

jobs.subject: two Japanese high-school students in classic school uniforms (not the recurring characters): a boy in a black gakuran jacket and a girl in a navy sailor-collar uniform with a red neckerchief, walking side by side through a school gate under cherry blossom trees, a small school building behind them; full figures

alt.vi: Trường cấp ba có hai học sinh mặc đồng phục.

jobs.subject: a friendly dentist in a white coat holding a small dental mirror, standing beside a dental chair

alt.vi: Nha sĩ đứng cạnh ghế khám răng.

generation.note: Không nhận ảnh tham chiếu; phong cách mô tả bằng prompt.

jobs.subject: a quiet library reading room: the male student politely points to an empty chair and asks a librarian at the desk for permission, and the librarian answers with an open palm gesture meaning go ahead; the woman already sits at the table reading with an electronic dictionary; tall bookshelves with blank spines, a window with soft daylight.

alt.vi: Trong thư viện, cậu sinh viên xin phép ngồi vào ghế trống.
